suite.title: Co-Evolution Plan Benchmark
suite.summary: Four plan-composition conditions run on identical planning tasks, scored by three blind automated judges in position-swapped pairwise trials.

judges.cli_version: curl 8.11.0 (x86_64-w64-mingw32) libcurl/8.11.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.1 brotli/1.1.0 zstd/1.5.6 libidn2/2.3.7 libpsl/0.21.5 libssh2/1.11.1

metric.label: Win rate
metric.rubric: Pairwise blind A/B judging — the standard rubric for this suite. Every condition meets every other condition on every task, twice per judge with the document order swapped. A win scores 1; a tie or a position-biased pair scores 0.5 to each side (PREREGISTRATION.md section 4); pairs dropped by sanitization or invalid evidence leave both the numerator and the denominator. 50% is parity with the rest of the field, and 100% means the condition won every comparison it was scored on.
metric.note: Reported separately for each judge and never adjudicated into a single score.

cost.label: Captured cost (floor)
cost.note: Sums every total_cost_usd in each cell's tokens sidecar. Claude reports that field; the direct GLM and Kimi sidecars report tokens without a price, and Codex has no sidecar. The number is therefore a floor, not a total. Judging cost is not included — the judge CLIs run without token capture.

completeness.note: Expected pairs assumes every condition survives sanitization and no cell is degraded. A nonzero unjudged count means every rate on this page is computed over what exists, not over what was planned.

conditions.label: solo
conditions.description: Single invoke_claude call on the fable-5 seat, using the byte-identical compose prompt the bouncer builds (co-evolve-bouncer.sh:785-787). No second pass, no critique, no revision.

conditions.label: codex-bounce
conditions.description: Cross-vendor bounce: Fable composes, Codex critiques and revises. Final document is Codex-revised (co-evolve-bouncer.sh seat semantics, odd passes review / even passes compose). Primary treatment under test.

conditions.label: panel
conditions.description: Fable composes; codex, glm, and kimi each critique independently with no rewrite access; Fable synthesizes a final revision accepting or rejecting each critique point on its merits. Exploratory condition.

conditions.label: self-bounce
conditions.description: Self-critique control: same mechanics as B but both bounce seats are Fable (--agents claude,claude), holding pass count constant. Isolates "any second pass helps" from "cross-vendor helps" — B-vs-D is the pre-registered secondary comparison.

preregistered.label: Secondary confirmatory: B (cross-vendor bounce) vs D (self-bounce)
